mapper.select: SELECT g.goal_id, g.user_id, g.name, g.target_amount, (g.initial_amount + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE goal_id = g.goal_id AND user_id = g.user_id), 0)) AS current_amount, g.initial_amount, g.start_date, g.due_date, g.is_main, g.status, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM goals g WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY g.is_main DESC, g.created_at DESC

SELECT g.goal_id, g.user_id, g.name, g.target_amount, (g.initial_amount + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE goal_id = g.goal_id AND user_id = g.user_id), 0)) AS current_amount, g.initial_amount, g.start_date, g.due_date, g.is_main, g.status, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM goals g WHERE g.goal_id = #{goalId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goals (user_id, name, target_amount, initial_amount, start_date, due_date, is_main) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{targetAmount}, #{initialAmount}, #{startDate}, #{dueDate}, #{isMain})
mapper.update: UPDATE goals SET name = #{name}, target_amount = #{targetAmount}, initial_amount = #{initialAmount}, start_date = #{startDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, is_main = #{isMain} WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}
UPDATE goals SET is_main = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_main = 1
